The search used an **Entrez-date bound through 2016-01-24**; it has no publication-date limit. Counts were run on 2026-09-30 against that bound.

**Known-record checks:** relative recall was 15/15 (100%) in the development set and 6/6 (100%) in the validation set. The validation set is only semi-independent: initial exploratory term ranking preceded the split. These figures do not estimate absolute sensitivity.

The optional trajectory block would have reduced results by 66.6% to 10,844, but it lost an eligible development record, and one eligible record appeared in its 30-record loss sample. The final 32,459-record count exceeds the 10,000-record standard budget. This workload risk was reviewed and documented.

The draft needs **human PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use**; the internal critique is not PRESS peer review.
